CommunityApplications.Profile:
Cinephage is a self-hosted media management application for automated movie and TV show acquisition, quality upgrades, subtitle sync, streaming, and library management.
This repository contains the official Unraid Docker template for Cinephage. The container image is published to ghcr.io/cinephage/cinephage and supports amd64 and arm64.
For support or to report issues, open an issue on the project's GitHub repository.
